independentZipTrial.input: Previously authored Sunrider source, kept outside this repository

limitations: No paid model-generated fresh film or live Mist UI chat was run in this publication test.
Native Mist tool tests run app code with isolated Electron/auth context and localhost catalog; they are not a production catalog refresh.
The ZIP trial used existing source, not newly generated UI or creative.
Portable export tested on macOS; Windows remains untested for this kit.
Standalone kit uses standard Three.js; path tracing needs a compatible separate adapter.
Automatic DOM-to-layer capture helper still needs an installed Storyboard capture environment; the portable renderer accepts pre-frozen page layers.
publication: PR for maintainer review; not merged
